tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and monocytosis with elevated basophils. There is also mild hypochloremic metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), and a slight increase in total bilirubin. Red cell indices and renal/liver function are otherwise within normal limits. Findings suggest possible infection or inflammatory process with impaired oxygenation; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
